description: Kemory: persistent memory for Claude Code. Hooks whose output is READ — SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse — must stay synchronous: an async hook's stdout is discarded, which would silently kill context injection and the read-only auto-approval while still appearing to run. They fail open instead, with every network call capped (3-6s) so a dead network never stalls a session. Capture writes and has no output anyone reads, so it runs async on both Stop and SessionEnd.

hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreCompact","additionalContext":"Context is about to be compacted. If this session established durable facts, decisions, or solved problems not yet in kemory, call kemory_consolidate_session (or kemory_store_memory for individual facts) NOW, before they are summarized away."}}'
